name: B10-0487/2026 (Renew) – Escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns missile and drone attacks by the Houthi militia on Saudi Arabia, including a strike on Riyadh airport that killed 13 people. It asks the European Union to treat the Houthis as a terrorist group, to sanction Iran for supplying them with weapons, and to send more naval ships to protect shipping in the Red Sea. It also calls for more aid to Yemen and a peace process led by Yemenis. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a law.

- The EU is asked to put the Houthis on its terrorist list; this affects the group and its funding.
- Member States are asked to send more warships to the Red Sea; this affects shipping escorts.
- The EU is asked to sanction Iran and arms suppliers; this affects those people and companies.
